participation.context: Spoke at the window, named no one, and sent nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You spoke once, low, and you did not write it. Nothing left the house. You turned the rest of the matter onto the girl and the hour.

title: Said two-and-twenty, and named the girl and nine

participation.context: Wrote the eleven lines, and did not copy them fair, and did not send them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote eleven lines before seven. She wants the day spent. You left them on the board.

title: Put eleven lines on her sheet
